item.description:
1 élément(s) retenu(s) par la veille quotidienne.

Apple OS — découvertes techniques

  1. PR #77999 — Use a transparency layer instead of a CGLayer for gradients with shadows
    WebKit · score 5/15 · confiance élevée
    Élément modifié. Pull request, état : closed Signaux : transparency.

    #### f293be74293ad8fe8fe9cf323e45001004ae858b Use a transparency layer instead of a CGLayer for gradients with shadows https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=328585 rdar://190779264 Reviewed by Said Abou-Hallawa. GraphicsContextCG paints gradients that have a drop shadow into a CGLayer, then draws the layer with the shadow applied. Paint them inside a transparency layer instead, applying the clip inside the layer so that it doesn't also clip away the shadow.
